space-4.description: Fine gaps (e.g., icon-to-text spacing, small status chips padding)

space-8.description: Micro padding and item gaps (e.g., list item padding, badge overlays)

space-12.description: Compact padding and gaps (e.g., action buttons padding, timeline entries)

space-16.description: Standard layout padding / gutter (e.g., smaller card padding, toolbar side padding)

space-24.description: Large card padding and structural margins (e.g., standard project card padding)

space-32.description: Workspace gutters (e.g., main margins surrounding layouts)

space-48.description: Section headers split, significant vertical spacers

space-64.description: Global toolbar height, high-level structural bands
